paite: Judah kumpipa Josiah tapa Jehoiakim vaihawm lai a TOUPA kiang a kipan a Jeremiah kiang a thu hong tung in:
heading: Jeremiah Leh Rekabte
english: The word which came to Jeremiah from Yahweh in the days of Jehoiakim the son of Josiah, king of Judah, saying,

paite: "Rekab inkote kiang ah hoh in va houpih inla, TOUPA inn a dantan khat ah pilut inla, uain dawn ding pia in," achi a.
english: Go to the house of the Rechabites, and speak to them, and bring them into the house of Yahweh, into one of the rooms, and give them wine to drink.

paite: Huan Habazziniah tapa, Jeremiah tapa, Jaazaniah leh a-unaute, atapa tengteng Rekab inkote tengteng toh ka pi a;
english: Then I took Jaazaniah the son of Jeremiah, the son of Habazziniah, and his brothers, and all his sons, and the whole house of the Rechabites;

paite: Pathian mipa Igdali tapa Hanan tate dantan, TOUPA inn ah ka pilut a; huai dantan bel heutute dantan chin kongpi ngakmi Shallum tapa Maaseiah dantan tung a om ahi.
english: and I brought them into the house of Yahweh, into the room of the sons of Hanan the son of Igdaliah, the man of God, which was by the room of the princes, which was above the room of Maaseiah the son of Shallum, the keeper of the threshold.

paite: Huchi in Rekab inkuante tapate ma ah belhbute, noute uain dim ka tung a, akiang uah, "Uain dawn un," ka chi hi.
english: I set before the sons of the house of the Rechabites bowls full of wine, and cups; and I said to them, Drink wine!

paite: Amau bel, "Uain ka dawn kei hial ding uh; kou hon suangpa Rekab tapa Jonadab in, 'Noumau leh na suante un leng tangtawn a uain na dawn ding uh ahi kei;
english: But they said, We will drink no wine; for Jonadab the son of Rechab, our father, commanded us, saying, You shall drink no wine, neither you, nor your sons, forever:

paite: inn na lam un haichi na tuh un, grephuan leng na bawl un na nei ding uh ahi sam kei hi; na damsung nite un puanin a na ten zawk ding uh ahi, na omna gam ua na damsawt theihna ding un, chi in thu ahon pia hi.'
english: neither shall you build house, nor sow seed, nor plant vineyard, nor have any; but all your days you shall dwell in tents; that you may live many days in the land in which you live.

paite: Huchi in kou hon suangpa Rekab tapa Jonadab in paukam a thu hon thukhah tengteng, ka damsung ua kou leh ka zite uh, ka tapate uleh ka tanute un uain dawn louh ding un,
english: We have obeyed the voice of Jonadab the son of Rechab, our father, in all that he commanded us, to drink no wine all our days, we, our wives, our sons, or our daughters;

paite: ka tenna inn uh lam louh ding, grephuan hiam lou hiam haichi hiam neih louh ding tan in ka zui uhi.
english: nor to build houses for us to dwell in; neither have we vineyard, nor field, nor seed:

paite: Puaninte ah ka teng zaw ua, kou hon suangpa Jonadab thupiak tengteng mang in ka zui vek uhi.
english: but we have lived in tents, and have obeyed, and done according to all that Jonadab our father commanded us.

paite: Huan hichi ahong hi a, Babulon kumpipa Nebukadnezzar in gam ahong sual lai in kou, 'Kisa un, Kaldai sepaihhonte leh Siria sepaihhonte lau ziak in Jerusalem ah i hoh ding uh,' ka chi ua, huchi in Jerusalem ah ka tengta uhi," achi uhi.
english: But it happened, when Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon came up into the land, that we said, Come, and let us go to Jerusalem for fear of the army of the Chaldeans, and for fear of the army of the Syrians; so we dwell at Jerusalem.

paite: Huan TOUPA thu Jeremiah kiang ahong tung nawn a
english: Then came the word of Yahweh to Jeremiah, saying,

paite: Israel' Pathian Sepaihte' TOUPA'N hichi in achi: Judah gam a mite leh Jerusalem a mi tengte kiang ah va gen inla, "Ka thute ngaikhe ding in sinsakna na sang kei ding uh maw? chih TOUPA thupawt ahi.
english: Thus says Yahweh of Armies, the God of Israel: Go, and tell the men of Judah and the inhabitants of Jerusalem, Will you not receive instruction to listen to my words? says Yahweh.

paite: Rekab tapa Jonadab thu, atapate kiang a apiak, uain dawn louh ding pen azui ua, tuni tan in bangmah adawn kei ua, amau suangpa thupiak azui mahmah uh hi; ke'n bel phalvak a thou in na kiang uah thu ka gen a, himahleh na hon ngaikhe kei uh.
english: The words of Jonadab the son of Rechab, that he commanded his sons, not to drink wine, are performed; and to this day they drink none, for they obey their father’s commandment: but I have spoken to you, rising up early and speaking; and you have not listened to me.

paite: Ka nasem zawlneite phalvak a thou in na kiang uah ka sawl a, michih na omdan gilou ua kipan hong kik vek unla, na thilhihte uh bawlhoih unla, pathian dangte zaw a-nna uh sem ding in zui kei unla; nou leh na pipute uh kiang a gam ka piak ah na teng ding uh chỉ in; himahleh na bil uh na doh kei ua, na hon ngaikhe sam kei uh.
english: I have sent also to you all my servants the prophets, rising up early and sending them, saying, Return now every man from his evil way, and amend your doings, and don’t go after other gods to serve them, and you shall dwell in the land which I have given to you and to your fathers: but you have not inclined your ear, nor listened to me.

paite: Rekab tapa Jonadab suante'n amau suangpa thupiak azui ua, hiai mite'n zaw ahon ngaikhe kei uh.
english: Because the sons of Jonadab the son of Rechab have performed the commandment of their father which he commanded them, but this people has not listened to me;

paite: Huaiziak TOUPA Israel' Pathian sepaihte' Pathian in hichi in achi: Ngai un, Judah leh Jerusalem a tengte tung ah thil hoih lou atung ua hong tung ding ka gen khiaksate ka hon tun ding; akiang uah thu ka gen a, angaikhe kei ua, amau ka sam a, ahon dawng sam kei uh," chi in.
english: therefore thus says Yahweh, the God of Armies, the God of Israel: Behold, I will bring on Judah and on all the inhabitants of Jerusalem all the evil that I have pronounced against them; because I have spoken to them, but they have not heard; and I have called to them, but they have not answered.

paite: Huchi in Jeremiah in Rekab suante kiang ah, Sepaihte' TOUPA Israel' Pathian in hichi in achi: "Na pa Jonadab thupiak na zui ua, athupawt tengteng bang a na hih ziak un;
english: Jeremiah said to the house of the Rechabites, Thus says Yahweh of Armies, the God of Israel: Because you have obeyed the commandment of Jonadab your father, and kept all his precepts, and done according to all that he commanded you;

paite: Rekab tapa Jonadab in tangtawn in ka ma a dingh ding mi atasam ngei kei ding," chi in Sepaihte' TOUPA Israel' Pathian in achi hi.
english: therefore thus says Yahweh of Armies, the God of Israel: Jonadab the son of Rechab shall not want a man to stand before me forever.
